The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
Done. Here is the summary.

## Goal
Run one live posting cycle on the signed-in account (`@tester.bluehaze.test`): post the exact text with a self-made image, then delete only that post, leaving everything else untouched.

## Action
1. **Made the image** — `./cover.png` (workspace): 1200×675 RGB PNG, harbor-themed background, title `Harbor Day 2026` drawn in 110pt Segoe UI white. Verified dimensions (1200×675, PNG) and that the title is actually rendered (14,105 bright pixels in the title region).
2. **Posted** — clicked "New post", filled the rich-text editor with exactly `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, uploaded `cover.png` via "Upload image", then set alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` via the "Add alt text" dialog, and clicked "Publish post".
3. **Deleted only that post** — opened the post's options menu on the specific post, chose "Delete post", and confirmed the "Delete this post?" dialog.
4. **Closed the browser** — closed the tab; confirmed no browser processes remain.

## Result
- The post was published (visible in the feed with the image and alt text) and then deleted.
- The full feed after deletion contains exactly the 7 pre-existing posts (Oct 21–27) with original dates and content, including the account's older post "Hello from the Bluehaze test account. Nothing to see here yet." No other posts were published or modified.

## How I know it is right
- **Text**: the compose textbox showed `value="Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on."` before publishing.
- **Image + alt text**: the feed showed `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."` (the alt text as the image's accessible name); the file is a verified 1200×675 PNG with the title rendered.
- **Deletion**: the post disappeared from the feed; the confirmation dialog was the only delete action taken.
- **Nothing else changed**: I read the full page text and confirmed all 7 original posts are present with unchanged dates/content, and there is no pagination hiding more.

## Assumptions (brief left these open)
- `./cover.png` is relative to the workspace (current working directory).
- "Title legible on it" = the title rendered as large, readable text on the image (I used 110pt white text).
- The alt text is set through the app's "Add alt text" field.
- "Only that post" = delete via the per-post options menu on the specific post I created, so no other post is affected.
